title: Making a Balatro-like game based on Rummy rules. Alpha gameplay footage.
author: TNS_Official

comments.author: TNS_Official
comments.body: We are making a Balatro-style game based on Rummy rules. Everything is generated in code, except the character cards. They are basically my friends in a 1-bit pixel avatar. So the final game will have multiple modes and each player can decide the way they want to finish a level. The progression is dependent on the choices the player makes, so the chances of two people having the same run is low.
